szoveg_eredeti:
One of the hottest topics these days centers in artificial intelligence (AI). If you're like I am, you asked the question, "What is it?" I looked it up on Google and found this answer, "AI is a type of computer technology that can do tasks usually requiring human thinking, like learning, solving problems, and understanding language." AI systems look at huge amounts of information to find patterns. Instead of following preset rules, AI looks at all of the information and suggests models to guess the best answers. So, what's the problem?
